answer: Forging thousands of identities means paying thousands of puzzle costs plus stake deposits that a canyon of verification nodes can slash. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity: each agent must solve a unique computational puzzle whose solution seeds a verifiable identity, and every action emits an echo of that seed. Like a raven marking territory, each identity is expensive to fake and cheap to audit, so a single actor swarming the network bears costs that scale linearly while honest agents amortize one puzzle across many legitimate actions.
